title: Back-of-the-envelope estimation and powers of two

kcs.statement: A day has 86,400 seconds, rounded to 10^5 for estimates, so 1 million events per day is about 10 per second.
2^10 ≈ 10^3 (KB), 2^20 ≈ 10^6 (MB), 2^30 ≈ 10^9 (GB), 2^40 ≈ 10^12 (TB), so byte counts can be converted with powers of ten in your head.
Estimates round inputs to one significant figure and aim for the right order of magnitude, stating each assumption aloud so the interviewer can correct it.
